mechanics.claim: Snowball Barrage can be recast twice within a short time at no additional cost, adding up to two extra volleys of damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Snowball Barrage'' can be recast twice within 3 seconds at no additional cost

mechanics.claim: Each cast volley (initial and each recast) is a separate ability activation, triggering on-cast effects independently.
mechanics.quote: Each cast volley of snowballs counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}

mechanics.claim: Each volley is also a separate cast instance, so the ability can generate up to 6 stacks of Conqueror across recasts.
mechanics.quote: Each volley of snowballs is also a separate {{tip|cast instance}}, allowing ''Snowball Barrage'' to generate 6 stacks of {{ri|Conqueror}}

mechanics.claim: The delayed root damage from Snowbound consumption does not trigger on-cast effects and does not count as a separate cast instance for Conqueror stacking.
mechanics.quote: ''Snowbound'' consumption does not trigger on-cast effects, neither does it count as a separate {{tip|cast instance}} (e.g. for the purposes of {{ri|Conqueror}})

mechanics.claim: Enemy champions and large monsters hit once by a volley are marked Snowbound, and subsequent hits refresh the mark rather than stacking it.
mechanics.quote: Enemy {{tip|champions}} and large {{tip|monsters}} hit once are marked ''Snowbound'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits

mechanics.claim: A target may only be slowed once by the ability's 3-hits slow, regardless of how many volleys land.
mechanics.quote: An enemy may be {{tip|slow|slowed}} only once for being hit by snowballs

mechanics.claim: The three snowballs of a single volley are thrown independently over 0.4 seconds, so a single cast can land as up to 3 separate damage instances.
mechanics.quote: The three snowballs are thrown independently from one another over the {{fd|0.4}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Ability has no cast time on either the initial cast or recasts.
